monitors.title: Watch list
monitors.lead: Keywords search for new posts. Only Reddit actually searches today. A pasted link is recognized by platform: a post goes to Needs reply, and your comment goes to Follow-ups. Only Reddit can check follow-ups automatically. Without a Reddit key, search stays at "not configured". Leads you add by hand still work.
monitors.keywordPlaceholder: For example copy ChatGPT equations Word
monitors.urlPlaceholder: A post or your comment link
monitors.urlHint: The platform comes from the link.
monitors.empty: No watches yet. Add a keyword or a link above.
